activity.notes: The Civilization mod's surname-only Yunupingu leader slot is identified in CIV Gold material as Galarrwuy Yunupingu, not Mandawuy Yunupingu. NAIDOC identifies Galarrwuy as leader of the Gumatj Clan since 1979; ATLAS records that community leadership through his death in 2023.

sources.title: Civilization IV Gold Mod leader roster
sources.citation_text: The CIV Gold roster expands the Aboriginal leader label to Galarrwuy Yunupingu, resolving the mod identity.

sources.title: Galarrwuy Yunupingu — NAIDOC Lifetime Achievement profile
sources.citation_text: Official NAIDOC profile describes Galarrwuy as a prominent Aboriginal leader and states that he was leader of the Gumatj Clan since 1979.
